chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Abu Jameela, from Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding
the fasting one who rinses his mouth: He said: 'He should not swallow his saliva until he spits it out three times.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on swallowing saliva while rinsing the mouth during fasting?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the technical details of madmadah (rinsing the mouth) to preserve the validity of the fast. It establishes a precautionary measure where the fasting person must expel saliva three times before swallowing, ensuring that any residual water or impurities are removed and do not invalidate the fast through accidental ingestion.
